summary: Phase 5.5e Expeditions Domain Split regression smoke COMPLETE. Live backend (https://guild-master-5.preview.emergentagent.com) verified GREEN end-to-end. Full pytest suite 159/159 PASS in 224.18s. New dedicated Phase 5.5e smoke file (16 tests, 16.06s) PASS 16/16. OpenAPI surface = 36 paths unchanged. /api/health → 200 {status:ok,env:development}. Tester login + is_admin=true verified. All expedition flows (start validation, list, detail, cross-guild 404, last-completed, replay-last, equipment delta snapshot immutability, dungeon gate sticky semantics, loot rarity rules, lazy completion idempotency) operate identically to pre-split server.py. Route order for /api/expeditions/last-completed and /api/expeditions/replay-last (before /{expedition_id}) confirmed correct via OpenAPI presence. Zero behaviour change confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: Domain split is clean: app/expeditions/ now contains schemas.py + services.py + routes.py with 5 endpoints; circular lazy imports successfully removed (app/guilds/routes.py and app/dungeons/services.py both eager-import from app.expeditions.services). Confirmed via test_openapi_path_count_36 (still 36) + test_cross_guild_detail_returns_404_not_403 (no 403 leak) + 159/159 baseline.
Loot rarity contract enforced: 5 forced-failure expeditions on Goblin Warrens produced ZERO Rare/Epic loot — Phase 7 loot table weights respected post-split.

Equipment delta snapshot fields (base_team_power, equipment_power_bonus, final_team_power, success_chance_without_equipment, success_chance_with_equipment, equipment_delta_text) all present on expedition document at start AND immutable after GET detail — Phase 7 immutability holds.

Lazy completion sweep is idempotent: 6 concurrent sweep triggers (3x /api/guilds/me + 3x /api/expeditions) on a single past-due expedition produced exactly ONE reward (inventory count stable across sweeps; expedition status remains 'completed').
Dungeon gate sticky semantics intact: dragons-hoard unlock_reason still mentions 'level 2', '65', and 'peak'; shadow-crypts still locked for fresh guild (0 adventurers).

Backend logs reload-clean across the regression run — no circular import warnings, no traceback noise. Tester seed remains idempotent ('Tester account already exists with is_admin=True' on every startup).

Pre-existing non-blocking notes from iteration_6 still apply: /api/admin/classes accumulates test-created classes (cosmetic), /api/auth/me wraps user under 'user' key, /api/recruitment/candidates returns 'candidate_id' field. None of these were affected by 5.5e.

test_credentials: tester@orbus.test / password123 (seeded idempotently in dev; is_admin=true forced on every startup)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5.5e domain split is GREEN. To rerun the dedicated smoke: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_phase55e_smoke_test.py -v (~16s, 16 tests, runs against live REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). To rerun the full regression: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q (~225s, 159 tests). The new smoke file uses live HTTP (not TestClient) and writes to Mongo directly via pymongo for the force-complete helper (mirrors backend_phase8_test.py pattern). Route-order assertion in test_openapi_paths_count_36 confirms /last-completed + /replay-last register before /{expedition_id} (an OpenAPI path missing would have failed the path-count check).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Phase 5.5e refactor is a pure code-organization change and produced zero behavioural regressions across 175 total test executions (159 baseline + 16 new smoke).
